geography: Approximately 3.7 km southeast of Ala near Kunming (Yunotubus fossil sample)
overview: The early Cambrian colony Yunotubus is represented by five fossil specimens preserving tubular housing and a stolon linking zooids. A morphology matrix tests its placement among pterobranchs without treating every Cambrian tube as a member of the group.

ecology.diet: Suspension feeding directly observed in Rhabdopleura normani; fossil diets are not generalized
ecology.habitat: Tube-dwelling marine colony in the sampled living Rhabdopleura normani
ecology.locomotion: Zooids remain in secreted tubes while feeding; colony-level locomotion was not observed
ecology.bodySize: Millimetre-scale zooids in the sampled living Rhabdopleura; not a class-wide size bound
ecology.guild: Suspension feeder in the living species directly studied

traits: Secreted tubular housing with fusellar construction in diagnostic fossil and living graptolithines
Colonial zooids interconnected by a stolon in Yunotubus and living rhabdopleurids
Tentaculate, ciliated feeding arms in directly observed living Rhabdopleura
evidenceSummary: The approximately 516 Ma colony preserves diagnostic tube construction and a stolon. Its pterobranch placement comes from morphology analysis; suspension feeding is directly observed only in living Rhabdopleura normani.

title.en: Tubes, zooids and a connecting stolon

text.en: Five Yunotubus specimens preserve a colony of zooids, tubular housing and a stolon linking the units. The study describes the tube as fusellar, built from repeated ring-like sections. These structures together, rather than a tube alone, support comparison with pterobranchs.
text.zh: 五件 Yunotubus 化石保存了由个虫、管状住所和连接各部分的匍匐茎组成的群体。研究将其管壁描述为由重复环状单元构成的箍节式结构。与羽鳃类比较时，依据的是这些结构的组合，而不是单凭管状外形。

title.en: A fossil placement and a living feeding sample
title.zh: 化石分类位置与现生摄食样本

text.en: A morphology matrix places Yunotubus within the pterobranch comparison, but this does not make every Cambrian tube a pterobranch. Suspension feeding by ciliated tentacles is directly described for living Rhabdopleura normani; the fossil colony’s diet and movement were not observed in the same way.
text.zh: 形态矩阵将 Yunotubus 放进羽鳃类比较框架，但这不表示所有寒武纪管状化石都属于羽鳃类。现生 Rhabdopleura normani 以纤毛触手悬浮摄食有直接观察记录；对化石群体的食性和运动方式没有同样的直接观察。

overviewZh: 寒武纪早期的群体 Yunotubus 由五件化石标本记录，保存了管状居所及连接各个虫体的匍匐枝。形态矩阵用于检验它在羽鳃类中的位置；不能因此把所有寒武纪管状化石都归入该类。
evidenceSummaryZh: 这处约 516 Ma 的群体化石保存了可用于鉴定的管状构造和匍匐枝。其归入头盘虫类是基于形态分析；悬浮摄食仅在现生的 Rhabdopleura normani 中得到直接观察。
